notes: The page continues a discussion of subdivisions, gives the surjection diagram S→I→J, and states that a refinement F≪G factors through a subdivision G′, with F≤G′≼G. Its marginal warning distinguishes a bijective order map from an order isomorphism. Item b) and a separate unfinished “Ainsi, … F” are cancelled. The handwritten page number is 25; no title or date is written on this leaf.

In a), the ink reads “G′ de F”, whereas the adjacent displayed G′≼G names G as the figure subdivided. The F has a straight stem and middle bar, so it remains F in the transcription. This is a local consistency observation, not a proof of the proposition (026-check-02).

The final lower index clearly reads x∈|F|\|G|. Under the intended support-extension construction, adjoining these singleton sets cannot enlarge the support beyond |F|; with |F|⊆|G| this index set is empty. To extend to |G| by singleton strata, the missing points would instead be |G|\|F|. H and S SA21-K5-02 give this mathematical repair; the transcription keeps the visible reverse order. The precise claim checked is the elementary support calculation, not admissibility of the resulting figure (026-check-01).

The cramped first-line formula ending and several overwritten or abbreviated groups remain doubtful. No word “tel” is visible after the cancelled “comme”, and no additional amalgamation sign is visible between F and the indexed coproduct. There is no explicit authorial “à vérifier” or question mark on this leaf.

The blind audit localizes both corrections within subdivision rather than duplicating a complete prefix. The marginal order sign is now securely preceq; the final preposition is preferred as dans, with donc still possible. The bottom first-line connector is preferred as avec. At its edge, only a lowered K-like/closing-brace-like mark is supported after x∈|F|; the formerly conjectured additional set difference is withdrawn. The second-line coproduct index still clearly reads |F| minus |G|. This textual difficulty is kept and is not repaired from the expected construction.

check_events.outcome: For support |F|=union(F), adjoining singletons indexed by |F|\|G| leaves the support |F| unchanged; if |F|⊆|G|, the index is empty. The intended support extension to |G| requires the missing-point set |G|\|F|. This is a support calculation only; no claim about all figure axioms is certified.
